subject: Group demo: brunch + evening cohort — host pairing and fallthrough plan
messages:
From: Susan Lee <susan@fastai.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, monica@redwood.com
Cc: partners@dataforge.io
Date: 2028-07-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Group demo — two windows for multiple prospects?

Hi Marcus / Monica —

Thanks again for offering to run a joint walkthrough for a small set of prospects who asked for both an earlier and later slot. We have three companies that want to join: Acme, Nimbus Analytics, and Drydock. To reduce churn, Susan from Acme suggested we offer a short morning session and a second evening window for APAC folks.

Proposed windows:
- Morning (brunch): Wed Jul 26, 08:30 PT / 11:30 ET — 35 minutes demo + 10 min Q/A
- Evening fallback: Wed Jul 26, 19:00 PT / Thu Jul 27, 03:00 SGT — same deck, live Q/A but we can record morning and do 15 min follow-up if attendance low

Questions: can Redwood staff cover both windows, or should we pair hosts so we have a clear fallthrough if someone is double-booked? Also, can you attach a short agenda and attendee list so I can send calendar invites?

Attendees on our side: Jordan Park (Acme) and Omar Patel (Nimbus). I'll loop in Drydock once we confirm times.

Thanks,
Susan
Director of Platform Partnerships
FastAI Labs

Attachments: none here (I can share attendee list once you confirm times)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lee <susan@fastai.io>, Jordan Park <jordan@acme.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, monica@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Group demo — two windows for multiple prospects?

Thanks Susan — happy to run these. Quick notes / proposal: 

1) Host pairing: I can lead the morning (08:30 PT) and Lauren can lead the evening (19:00 PT). Monica will be available as floater for account-specific Qs and to handle access/links in the chat. That gives us clear ownership and reduces risk of a no-show.

2) Agenda + logistics: I attached a one-pager agenda (agenda-inference-brief.pdf) and a CSV with the current attendee emails (cohort-attendees.csv). Please confirm final attendees and whether Drydock needs an invite.

3) Fallthrough plan: if Lauren or I are unexpectedly double-booked, we propose: a) auto-forward recorded morning session link to evening registrants, and b) offer a short 15-min follow-up with the assigned AE. We also attached a combined calendar (.ics) that creates both holds with the correct time zones — we'll finalize the calendar times after your confirmation.

4) Recording / permission: We will record morning by default; if any company objects, we will disable recording for that attendee's portion. Please confirm permission for recording and distribution to registered attendees.

Next step: can you confirm final attendees by Monday 07/24 and whether Drydock will join the morning or evening slot? If yes, I'll publish calendar invites and include the Drive agenda link.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: agenda-inference-brief.pdf; cohort-attendees.csv; merge-calendar.ics

Quick — happy to lead evening. Small ask: can we nudge the evening start to 19:15 PT? That gives the UK folks time to finish calls and still hit 23:15 BST (not ideal but workable). If 19:00 is locked, I can still cover.

Also recommend we split responsibilities on the invite: host (deck + demo flow) vs AE (license/pricing Qs + next steps). That helps when multiple prospects with different procurement timelines attend.

—Lauren
